d: Jet black hair is styled in a high, voluminous ponytail with thick, sweeping bangs framing a youthful, adolescent face. The golden-amber eyes are narrow and sharp, conveying a focused, mischievous expression. A slender build is dressed in an olive green military-style jacket over a white t-shirt with red lettering, a short black pleated skirt, white socks, and chunky black lace-up boots. Signature details include red-rimmed glasses perched on the head, a black choker, a band-aid on the right knee, and a large mechanical oxygen tank apparatus on the back connected to a handheld megaphone via a coiled black cable.
